question: I'm following along with this salad recipe. Please guide me through each step as it happens.

ground_truth.response: Chop one small head of romaine lettuce into bite-sized pieces and place them in a large mixing bowl.
Finely dice one medium red onion and add it to the bowl with the lettuce.
Chop two medium tomatoes into small chunks and add them to the salad mixture.
Slice three medium cucumbers lengthwise, then cut them into small cubes and add them to the bowl.
Slice three ounces of black olives into thin rings and add them to the vegetables.
Finely chop half a bunch of Italian parsley and a quarter bunch of mint leaves, then add them to the bowl.
Slice half a bunch of radishes into thin rounds and place them on top of the salad.
Cut one pita bread into quarters, place them in a baking dish, and toast in the oven until golden brown.
Whisk together 1/4 cup olive oil, Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp white wine vinegar, salt, and black pepper for the first dressing.
Pour the oil dressing over the salad and toss. Break the toasted pita into pieces and mix them in.

ground_truth.response: For the second dressing, mix 3/4 cup plain yogurt, 2 tbsp tahini, juice from 1/3 lemon, salt, and pepper.
Finely chop one ounce of fresh dill and stir it into the yogurt dressing until smooth.
Plate a portion of the salad. Sprinkle with sumac, then top with the yogurt dressing and dried basil.
